answer: A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The glacier multiplier is published, charged in tide, and mirror lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 8 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 4026 identities would post 4143 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
